verdict.rationale: telli's built-in AI assistant Charlie is documented as able to "analyze your calls", and the platform tracks success rate and call outcome fields. However, nothing shows the AI automatically scoring call quality, flagging failed calls, or assessing resolution without being asked; call feedback is submitted by humans. missing for 10: automatic per-call AI quality scoring, automated failure flagging, AI resolution analysis, detailed docs on Charlie's call-review behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI reviews my calls for me — scoring quality, flagging failures, and analyzing resolution automatically
